sections.text: Python, OpenCV, Computer Vision, Git, AWS, Docker

Computer Vision Engineer (Junior), Drishti Analytics (Jan 2025 - Aug 2026). Built OpenCV and PyTorch pipelines for retail shelf analytics, owned the annotation tooling in Python, and worked through pull requests on a shared Git repository.
Deployed a vision inference service to AWS using Docker containers for a college showcase, including a public demo endpoint.
My strength is perception and vision. I have touched ROS 2 only briefly and would be learning it on the job.
